name: Table
purpose: Displays tabular data edge-to-edge — rows and columns of related records, e.g. a member list, a billing history.
neverUseFor: A single record's key/value details — use a description list pattern instead
Card-wrapped individual rows — Table rows are edge-to-edge by design, never wrap one row in a Card
Non-tabular free-form content — Table is for genuinely row/column data, not a generic layout grid

anatomy.description: Root — always a native <table>, always 100% width of its container.
One row. Hover is CSS-only (:hover), never a JS mouseenter/mouseleave handler.
One data cell — content is fully consumer-controlled (text, Badge, Avatar, Button, ...).

props.name: children
props.description: Table content — typically a TableHead and a TableBody.

a11y.role: table (implicit — native <table>/<thead>/<tbody>/<tr>/<th>/<td> already carries full table semantics, nothing hand-rolled)
